title: pouzolzia indica subvar. muralis
intro: Pouzolzia indica subvar. muralis, commonly known as "Gentian-violet" or "Kakamachi," is a plant species in the family Urticaceae. It is a traditional medicinal herb used in various cultures, particularly in Asia, for its health-promoting properties. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial actions, which may help to alleviate conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Pouzolzia indica subvar. muralis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
